name: node-analytics
description: Audience Signal — a Node on GROUNDED. Owned-data audience-resonance analytics for an investigative newsroom.
comment_dependencies: The runtime provides BOTH entrypoints (createServer local, createHostedServer online) and all their deps (express/multer/mammoth/anthropic + lazy pg/cookie-parser/jsonwebtoken). This Node only adds pdf-parse + word-extractor, used by lib/extract.js for .pdf / legacy .doc uploads (lazy-imported; a .docx-only install never loads them). Optional so a flaky build can't break a local install.
